title: Add the ability to set auto dimming to 100% without powering off a display to allow waking a TV with mouse
line: Automatic dimming can now go all the way to a black screen that stays on, so TVs don't show "no signal".
explanation: Automatic dimming always dimmed to 30%, and the only way to get a black screen was "Turn off screen", which stops sending a signal, so TVs show their "no signal" screen and follow their own power-off rules. KWin also couldn't dim a screen fully in software: dimming was applied before a 5 nit minimum, so even a dimming factor of 0 left the screen a visible grey (48/255). KWin now applies dimming to the reference luminance after that minimum, down to the black level, and the power settings get a "Partially / To black" choice next to "Dim automatically" that makes powerdevil dim to 0 instead of 30%.

commits.message:
backends/drm: let software dimming reach black

Dimming was applied to the brightness factor before the 5 nit floor, so
a fully dimmed screen stayed a visible grey. Dimming now scales the
reference luminance after the floor, down to just above the black level.

BUG: 518672

Add an option to dim the screen to black

Automatic dimming always stopped at 30%, and turning the screen off cuts
the signal, so TVs show "no signal" instead of a black screen. A new "To
black" choice next to "Dim automatically" dims fully and keeps it on.

BUG: 518672

media.caption: Power settings on master: dimming has only a timeout, always to 30%.
New choice next to "Dim automatically": Partially (as before) or To black.
What a TV receives on master when KWin is asked to dim fully (simulated with KWin's own colour code): still a visible grey picture.
Same with the fix: the signal is pure black (every pixel 0) while the screen stays on.
